keyword: what time does the artemis 2 land
claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft splashed down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT) on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The splashdown marked the conclusion of a 10-day mission.
The 10-day mission took four astronauts around the moon.
The crew was retrieved by the USS John P. Murtha after splashdown.
Re-entry, featuring a plasma blackout, began shortly before splashdown.
The mission included NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
